chunks: 1 - Abu Ja'far Muhammad ibn Ali ibn al-Husayn ibn Musa ibn Babawayh al-Qummi (may Allah be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Umar al-Baghdadi al-Hafiz narrated to us. He said: Abdullah ibn Yazid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Thawab narrated to us. He said: Ishaq ibn Mansur narrated to us, from Kadih -- meaning Abu Ja'far al-Bajali --, from Abdullah ibn Lahi'a, from Abd al-Rahman -- meaning Ibn Ziyad --, from Salama ibn Yasar, from Jabir ibn Abdullah. He said:
When Ali (peace be upon him) came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) with the conquest of Khaybar,

the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and his family) said to him: Were it not that sects of my nation would say about you what the Christians said about the Messiah Jesus son of Mary, I would have said about you today a statement such that you would not pass by any gathering except that they would take the dust from beneath your feet and seek healing from the remainder of your ablution water. But it suffices you that you are from me and I am from you; you inherit from me and I inherit from you. You are to me in the position of Harun to Musa, except that there is no prophet after me. You will fulfill my covenant and fight upon my sunnah. Tomorrow you will be my vicegerent at the Pond. You will be the first to come to me at the Pond, and the first to be clothed with me, and the first from my nation to enter Paradise. Your followers will be upon pulpits of light, with illuminated faces around me; I will intercede for them, and tomorrow they will be my neighbours in Paradise. Your war is my war, and your peace is my peace. Your secret is my secret, and your public affairs are my public affairs. The innermost thoughts of your heart are like mine. Your descendants are my descendants. You will fulfill my promises. The truth is with you, and the truth is upon your tongue, in your heart, and between your eyes. Faith is mixed into your flesh and blood just as it has mixed into my flesh and blood. No one who hates you will ever come to me at the Pond, and no one who loves you will be absent from it until they come to the Pond with you.

He said: So Ali (peace be upon him) fell in prostration, then said: Praise be to Allah who blessed me with Islam, taught me the Quran, and made me beloved to the best of creation, the Seal of the Prophets and the Master of the Messengers -- as an eminence and a favour from Him upon me.
He said: Then the Prophet (may Allah bless him and his family) said: Were it not for you, the believers would not be recognized after me.

key_terms.الحوض: The Pond (Hawd) of Kawthar - a reservoir in the afterlife where the Prophet will receive his followers
key_terms.بمنزلة هارون من موسى: In the position of Harun (Aaron) to Musa (Moses) - a famous Prophetic statement establishing Ali's unique status, drawn from the Hadith of Manzila
key_terms.خاتم النبيين: Seal of the Prophets - title of Prophet Muhammad as the final prophet
key_terms.خليفتي: My vicegerent/successor - indicating political and spiritual authority after the Prophet
key_terms.شيعتك: Your followers (Shi'a) - those who support and follow Ali

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Imam Ali after the conquest of Khaybar about his virtues and station?
ai.summary: In this hadith from Al-Amali of Sheikh al-Saduq, the Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) addresses Imam Ali (AS) after the conquest of Khaybar (7 AH), enumerating his unparalleled virtues: Ali's station is like Harun to Musa, he is the Prophet's spiritual heir and vicegerent at the Pond of Kawthar, the first to enter Paradise from the Muslim nation, and the embodiment of truth. The Prophet affirms the complete unity between them in war, peace, secrets, and inner nature, and declares that Ali's followers will have illuminated faces in Paradise. Ali responds with gratitude to Allah, and the Prophet concludes that without Ali, the true believers would not be distinguishable after him.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu Ja`far Muhammad b. `Ali b. al-Husayn b. Musa b. Babuwayh al-Qummi (ra) narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. `Umar al-Baghdadi al-Hafith narrated to us. He said: `Abdullah b. Yazid narrated to us. He said: Muhammad b. Thawab narrated to us. He said: Ishaq b. Masnur narrated to us from Kadih – meaning Aba Ja`far al-Bajali – from `Abdullah b. Lahi`a from `Abd al-Rahman – meaning Ibn Ziyad from Salama b. Yasar from Jabir b. `Abdullah. He said:
When `Ali (as) went to the Messenger of Allah (s) in the conquest of Khaybar,

the Messenger of Allah (s) said to him: If sects from my Nation would not claim for you what the Christians have claimed for the Messiah Jesus the son of Mary, I would have said something about you today that would cause the people to take the dust from beneath your feet and seek treatment from it due to the excellence of your purity. However, it is enough [to say] that you are from me and I am from you. You inherit from me, and I inherit from you. You are to me as Harun was to Musa, except there is no prophet after me. You fight upon my Sunna, and tomorrow you will be upon the Pond as my vicegerent. You will be the first to return to me at the Pond, and you will be the first to be gowned with me. You will be the first to enter Paradise from my Nation, and your followers will be upon pulpits made of light with illuminated faces around me. I will intercede for them, and tomorrow they will be my neighbours in Paradise. Your war is my war, and your peace is my peace. Your secret is my secret, and your pronouncement is my pronouncement. Your peace at heart is like my peace. Your descendants are my descendants. You will encounter my enemies. The truth is with you, and the truth is upon your tongue, in your heart, and upon your forehead. Faith is mixed into your flesh and blood just as it is mixed into my flesh and blood. No one that hates you will return to me at the Pond, and no one that loves you will be absent from it – they will return to the Pond with you.

He said: So, `Ali (as) fell in prostration, then said: “Praise be to Allah, who blessed me with Islam, and taught me the Qur'an, and made me love the best of people, the Seal of Prophets and Master of Messengers; as an eminence and a favour from Him.”
He said: So, the Prophet (s) said: Were it not for you, the believers would not be recognizable after me.
